+// Conditional debug logger: compiled out in non-Debug builds
+#if DEBUG
+@inline(__always)
+private func debugLog(_ message: @autoclosure () -> String) {
+	print(message())
+}
+#else
+@inline(__always)
+private func debugLog(_ message: @autoclosure () -> String) {}
+#endif
